description: Create a new, empty knowledge graph (space) owned by the authenticated user; use when you need a fresh space to populate. Returns `{id, url, name, slug, role, memberRole, createdAt, onboardingThreadId, onboardingThreadUrl}` - use the returned `id` as `graphId` for subsequent tool calls. The space starts empty (no schema, no nodes); follow up with `naumu_update_schema` to register types before any `naumu_add_node` calls. When you mention the space, write [its name](url).

name.description: Display name for the new space. A URL slug is generated from this name.

name: naumu_create_graph
title: Create Graph
